name: Help article from a resolved issue
summary: Turn every answer your team works out once into an article the next customer finds on their own. Hand over a resolved ticket and your list of articles; get back a draft in your customers' words, with their details removed and every step traced to the ticket. Your knowledge-base owner decides what goes live.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own rules for prepared work: the record as the only authority, every statement traced to its source, customer details removed and recorded, and a person who approves and publishes.

sources.contribution: The method this template adapts: identify the problem, the fix, who it affects and how often it arises; choose an article type (how-to, troubleshooting, question and answer, known issue) with a section shape for each; write for search with customer wording, exact error text and alternative phrasings; check existing articles to decide between an update and a new article; hand over with category, tags, audience, publishing notes, a reviewer and a review date; and a trial of the steps by a colleague new to the issue before publishing.
